entries.en: This map is out of date; the footbridge was removed last winter.
entries.zh: 这张地图已经过时了；那座人行桥去年冬天已被拆除。

entries.en: The ticket machine is out of order, so we'll have to pay at the counter.
entries.zh: 售票机坏了，所以我们得去柜台付款。

entries.en: Year by year, the village school attracted more pupils from nearby farms.
entries.zh: 村里的学校每年都吸引到更多来自附近农场的学生。

entries.en: She sent her former teacher a birthday card year after year.
entries.zh: 她年复一年地给从前的老师寄生日贺卡。

entries.en: We went from door to door asking neighbours whether they had seen our missing cat.
entries.zh: 我们挨家挨户询问邻居，是否见过我们走失的猫。

entries.en: You don't need my help; try solving the problem on your own first.
entries.zh: 你不需要我帮忙；先试着自己解决这个问题。

entries.en: She called his name again, but to no effect; he kept walking.
entries.zh: 她又叫了一遍他的名字，但没有用；他仍然继续往前走。

entries.en: I agree with you to a certain extent, but the cost still worries me.
entries.zh: 我在某种程度上同意你的看法，但费用仍让我担心。

entries.en: The route is longer, but we shouldn't rule it out on that account.
entries.zh: 这条路线较长，但我们不该因为这一点就排除它。

entries.en: I can't discuss the details at this moment; my train is about to leave.
entries.zh: 我现在没法讨论细节；我的火车马上就要开了。

entries.en: The volunteers cheered with one accord when the final result was announced.
entries.zh: 最终结果公布时，志愿者们齐声欢呼。

entries.meaningZh: 变得完全认不出来；完全变样
entries.en: The old station has changed out of all recognition since the new platforms were built.
entries.zh: 新站台建成后，老车站已经变得完全认不出来了。
